comments.body: Cross-branch P1 E2E finding for FE review: **issue #56** documents a *real Playwright* S09 failure where rapid B→A→B Undo left the server on stale A (test branch's earlier inline autosave). This PR has a different `useDraftPersistence.ts` hook with queued/serial saves and version guards, so please validate the actual new hook rather than transplanting the old `triggerAutosave` patch. Acceptance includes B→A→B before debounce, A in-flight→B, chapter/account switching, version-conflict recovery, immutable revision/outbox consistency and fresh Playwright readback. Exact repro/evidence and minimal required tests: https://github.com/Ephurin/Novel_sharing_platform/issues/56 . Please link your FE fix/test commit before P1 Codex safely ports the relevant patch to the isolated test branch; no merge of this whole PR into P1 without compatibility review.
